clips.end_words: this is your exercise called dream building
clips.caption:
Writing your goal down is step one. Here's the step after it that almost nobody does: go physically touch the thing.

Want a car? Go to the dealership, sit in it, touch the wheel, smell the interior. Want a Rolex? Go put it on your wrist and have someone take a photo of you wearing it. It sounds like a gimmick, but it isn't — touching something in the physical universe changes your energy around it, and that's what actually speeds up how fast it shows up in your life.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the rest of the technique.
